# Log

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Log:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | A number above 0. |

**Returns:** The natural logarithm.

## Description

Returns the natural logarithm (base e) of a number. For base 10 use [Log10](Log10).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Log(10)
```

```text
2.30259
```
